title: Make a Cat Then Animate
tests: Tests completing picture creation and animation from one message, delivering both assets with matching subjects.

faults.what: The cat has two distinct striped tails in both the illustration and video: one extends to the left and swishes, while another hangs over the sill on the right.
The video is listed as 5.2 seconds rather than the requested 5 seconds.

judge.summary: The square illustration and matching animation capture the requested sunny scene and blinking motion, but the cat visibly has two tails.

must_haves.item: Both a standalone still picture and a playable 5-second video are delivered.
must_haves.why: A standalone PNG and frames from an MP4 are supplied; the reported video duration is approximately five seconds, at 5.2 seconds.

must_haves.item: Both outputs are square and show an orange cat wearing a blue scarf on a sunny windowsill.
must_haves.why: The still and all supplied video frames are square and clearly depict these elements.

must_haves.item: The animation visibly matches the delivered illustration's cat, scarf and setting.
must_haves.why: The orange tabby, blue scarf, window, plant, and draped fabric remain recognizably consistent.

must_haves.item: The cat visibly blinks and its tail gently moves; the video is not merely a still image with a camera zoom.
must_haves.why: The eyes are closed in the 0.6-second frame and open in later frames, while the left-side tail changes position independently of the body and setting.

must_haves.item: The video has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: Audio cannot be assessed from the supplied still frames.
